title: 第二十章 锦王被掳 黑蝠窜逃第二十一章 宝蓝妖蝶 天香蝶粉
content_zh:
“我们施展‘鬼影追魂术’暗暗尾随。这波人个个身手敏捷，几番纵跃，便来到万老爷子的内宅里院。不多时，万老爷子卧室的窗纱上开始显现出数条重重叠叠的黑影，而里院外围则多了不少家丁、武士。”
“我们敛息屏神，分别潜伏在屋顶，窗沿，向屋内窥视过去。屋内共有七个人，万老爷子，万青城，还有五个番邦人士。万青城肃立一旁，面带紧张之色。万老爷子居中而坐，不住地咳嗽气喘。五个番邦人士围绕着万老爷子盘腿而坐。他们平伸双臂，袖底飘摆，真气鼓荡，一起发功，给万老爷子驱毒疗伤。而在万老爷子的头顶，悬空浮着一块飘散着寒气，晶莹透亮的白色事物！”
“那番邦五人一起运气发功，持续了将近两个时辰。眼瞅着那个白色物事，一点一点变小，最后竟然化作一滩白浆自万老爷子的天灵处慢慢渗入体内。”
“起初，我们并不知道那就是“白玉观音”。一直以为，万青城请来了能人异士来为他父亲治病。但是接下来的谈话却令我们大吃一惊。”
“随着运功的结束，那五人慢慢地睁开了双眼，收敛真气，立起身来。而在一旁焦灼等待的万青城立马凑上前去，问道：“父亲怎么样了？‘白玉观音’对父亲有效果吗？”
“那五人之中有一个矮个子，身材佝偻，头扎两抹外族细辫，皮肤黝黑发亮，鼻下两撇鼠须极其醒目，只听那人说道：“我已把白玉观音集合我五人之力化作药引，逼入‘锦王’体内！你且耐心等待结果！”
“闻听此言，我顿觉此事极为重要，想立马折回禀告左右使。但是我们刚要走出内院，便立觉内院外围四周瞬间多出了许多暗哨，盯梢，几乎整个别院的家丁，武士都出来执勤。而其中不乏万青城花费重金请来的武林高手！”
“而回想我们初入别院之时，都一直使用‘鬼影追魂术’迅疾如飞，落地无声，这些讨厌的尾巴应该不是我们招惹来的！应该是万家出于保守“白玉观音”这一秘密的缘故！”
“我顿觉不妙，为了不打草惊蛇，我们只得屏声匿形藏身在别院之中，一边继续监视万锦王，一边寻找时机溜出去。但是整整一晚，家丁，武士不眠不休！”
鬼灯点点头说道：“那晚，‘白玉观音’现身，事出突然。万家自然要多设提防。而且按照你们的描述，那几个番邦人是翻入别院的，并没有人出来接应，说明万家事先并不知道这五人会带着‘白玉观音’来为万锦王治病的！”
鬼灯瞅了一眼万锦王，续道：“至于你的所见应该不假！这白玉观音显然就在万锦王体内！不过这老废物如何能消化的了如此至宝，真是可惜！待我们把这老废物抓回幽冥鬼府，再驱力将“白玉观音”给逼出来！”
鬼衣继续追问道：“那么，那五个外族人士的去向呢？这么多天来，锦王一直呆在他的卧室吗？期间有没其他人再次接触过他呢？”
“没有。自从那晚以后，五个外族人士就像人间蒸发一般，再也没有露过面。锦王一直处在我们的监视之下，一步也没有离开过房间。期间万青城来过几次，不过是来探望他的父亲，没有过多举动，除了哀嚎，就是给父亲擦汗、穿衣。还有就是，每天定时都有丫环送来食物和茶水。”
鬼衣若有所思地点了点头，转身对鬼灯说道：“哥，你先带万锦王回幽冥鬼府复命，我迟些时候再回去！”
鬼灯疑惑不解地问道：“为何？”
鬼衣沉声说道：“这一切看上去滴水不漏，但我总觉得有些地方不大对劲。首先‘蝶门宗’迟迟没有露面，这个计划进行的太过于顺利了，反而让我觉得不妥！还有一点最是让我感到疑惑！”
“哦？”
“这个万青城乍一看上去，虽说不像是一个狡诈之人，内无城府。但是他却在今天突然病倒，有点匪夷所思！仿佛他就料到了今天万家会出大事一般！”
鬼灯哈哈一笑：“你说的这个万青城，我早有耳闻。在余公公口中，他不过是一个胸无城府，胆小怕事的小畜生。带着一股书生气，做事畏首畏尾，怕他作甚！至于蝶门宗，早已绝迹江湖多年，威信已无。他的帮众突然现身万锦别院，也区区只有两人，未见得整个蝶门宗已卷土重来！而现在我们幽冥鬼府如日中天，万千帮众，家大业大。他们也必然忌惮我们三分，我看是蝶门宗不敢来了吧！”
鬼衣摇摇头，淡淡地说道：“虎行捕猎，必先俯其身，屏其息，持久蓄力，厚积薄发，一招制敌！暴风雨前多是宁静的午后，老虎发威之前必然丛林俱寂！现在的这一切，太过于平静了，平静得有点诡异！你们先回去！待我再观察几天。如若万家不再发生什么事的话，我敢肯定这次我们真的做成了！”

“但是假如。。。”鬼衣眼眸深邃，盯着万锦别院良久之后，说道：“假使我七日之内没有回去的话，那么你速速派人来，可能我有**烦！最好你能请的动‘鬼府五灵官’出山，助我一臂之力！蝶门宗真的不可小觑啊！”
杨城荒郊，小孤峰，绿川驿道。
驿道上迎面走来了一个卜卦师，他黄纱遮面，步履蹒跚，身材佝偻，左肩扛一个破布麻袋，里面鼓囊囊的，不知是何物。而他的右手拄着一根长竹竿，上面挑着一条竖幡，竖幡上写着八个大字：行符改运指点迷津。
这位卜卦师步履艰难，不时扶一扶肩头的重物，还伴随着几声剧烈的咳嗽声。路过的行人都带着同情的眼神瞟上一两眼，随后说一句：“老人家真不容易啊！”而旁人却不可能相信，这位不起眼的“老人”正是曾经威赫武林的“蝶门宗”四大长老之一——黑蝠长老万青山！
content_en:
"We used the 'Ghost Soul Chasing Technique' to follow them secretly. This wave of people were all agile, and after several leaps, they arrived at the inner courtyard of Mr. Wan's house. Not long after, several overlapping black shadows began to appear on the window screen of Mr. Wan's bedroom, and there were many servants and warriors outside the inner courtyard."
"We held our breath and lurked on the roof and along the windows, peering into the house. There were seven people in the house, Mr. Wan, Wanqingcheng, and five foreigners. Wanqingcheng stood aside with a nervous look on his face. Mr. Wan sat in the middle, coughing and wheezing. . The five foreigners sat cross-legged around Mr. Wan. They stretched out their arms, their sleeves fluttered, and they worked together to exorcise the poison and heal Mr. Wan's injuries. And above Mr. Wan's head, there was a crystal clear white thing floating in the air!
"The five people from that country worked together by luck, and it lasted for nearly two hours. They watched the white thing get smaller little by little, and finally turned into a pool of white liquid that slowly seeped into Mr. Wan's body from his heavenly spirit."
"At first, we didn't know that it was the White Jade Guanyin. We always thought that Wanqing City invited talented people to treat his father's illness. But the following conversation surprised us."
"As the exercise ended, the five people slowly opened their eyes, gathered their energy, and stood up. Wan Qingcheng, who was waiting anxiously on the side, immediately stepped forward and asked, "How is father? Is ‘White Jade Guanyin’ effective for my father? "
"Among the five people, there was a short man with a stooped figure, two thin foreign braids on his head, dark and shiny skin, and two extremely eye-catching rat whiskers under his nose. I heard that man say: "I have turned the white jade Guanyin into a medicine guide with the power of five of us, and forced it into the body of the 'Jin King'! Just wait patiently for the results! "
"After hearing this, I suddenly felt that this matter was extremely important, and I wanted to go back and report it to the envoys immediately. But as soon as we were about to walk out of the inner courtyard, we immediately noticed that there were many secret sentries around the perimeter of the inner courtyard. They were watching, and almost all the servants and warriors from other courtyards came out to go on duty. Among them were many martial arts masters hired by Wanqing City at a huge cost!"
"Recalling that when we first entered the other courtyard, we all used the 'Ghost Soul Chasing Technique' as fast as flying and falling to the ground silently. These annoying tails should not be caused by us! It should be because the Wan family keeps the secret of the 'White Jade Guanyin'!"
"I suddenly felt something bad. In order not to alert others, we had no choice but to hide in the other courtyard and continue to monitor King Wanjin while looking for opportunities to sneak out. But the whole night, the servants and warriors were awake!"
Gui Deng nodded and said: "That night, the 'White Jade Guanyin' appeared, and things happened suddenly. The Wan family naturally had to be more vigilant. And according to your description, those foreigners broke into other courtyards, and no one came out to respond. It means that the Wan family did not know in advance that these five people would bring the 'White Jade Guanyin' to treat King Wanjin!"
Ghost Deng glanced at King Wanjin and continued: "As for what you saw, it should be true! This White Jade Guanyin is obviously in King Wanjin's body! But how can this old waste digest such a treasure? What a pity! After we capture this old waste back to the Netherworld Ghost Mansion, we can force the "White Jade Guanyin" out!"
Guiyi continued to ask: "So, where are the five foreigners? Has King Jin stayed in his bedroom for so many days? Has anyone else contacted him again during this period?"
"No. Since that night, the five foreigners have just disappeared from the world and have never been seen again. King Jin has always been under our surveillance and has never left the room. During this period, Wanqingcheng came a few times, just to visit his father. He didn't do much except wailing, wiping his father's sweat and dressing him. Also, the maids brought food and tea at regular times every day."
Gui Yi nodded thoughtfully., turned around and said to Ghost Deng: "Brother, you take King Wanjin back to Netherworld Ghost Mansion to recover first, I will go back later!"
Gui Deng asked in confusion: "Why?"
Gui Yi said in a deep voice: "All this seems to be watertight, but I always feel that something is not quite right. First of all, the 'Diemen Sect' has not shown up yet. This plan is going too smoothly, but it makes me feel wrong! There is another thing that makes me puzzled the most!"
"Oh?"
"At first glance, this Wanqing City does not look like a cunning person with no city palace. But he suddenly fell ill today, which is a bit unbelievable! It's as if he expected that something big would happen to the Wan family today!"
Gui Deng laughed loudly: "I have heard about the Wanqing City you are talking about. In Eunuch Yu's mouth, he is just a timid and fearful little beast with no ambition. With a bookish spirit, he is timid in doing things for fear of what he will do! As for the Diemen Sect, it has been extinct for many years, and its prestige is No more. Only two of his gang members suddenly appeared in Wanjin Villa, but it seems that the entire Butterfly Sect has made a comeback! And now that our Netherworld Ghost Mansion has thousands of gang members and a big business, they must be afraid of us. I think the Butterfly Sect doesn't dare to come!"
Gui Yi shook his head and said calmly: "When a tiger hunts, he must first bend over, hold his breath, accumulate strength for a long time, accumulate strength, and defeat the enemy with one move! It is usually a quiet afternoon before the storm, and the jungle must be silent before the tiger shows its power! Everything now is too peaceful, and it is a bit weird! You go back first! Wait for me to observe for a few more days. If nothing else happens to Wanjia, I am sure we have really done it this time!"
"But what if..." Gui Yi stared at Wanjin Villa for a long time with deep eyes, and said: "If I don't go back within seven days, then you send someone quickly, maybe I am in trouble! It's best if you can ask the 'Five Spiritual Officials of the Ghost Mansion' to come out and help me! The Butterfly Sect is really not to be underestimated!"
The deserted suburbs of Yangcheng, the small solitary peak, and the Green River Post Road.
A fortune teller came towards me on the post road. His face was covered with yellow gauze, his steps were staggering, his stature was stooped, and he carried a rag sack on his left shoulder. There was something bulging inside, and he didn't know what it was. His right hand is holding a long bamboo pole, with a vertical flag on it. There are eight big characters written on the vertical flag: running symbols change luck and provide guidance.
The fortune teller walked with difficulty, holding the weight on his shoulders from time to time, accompanied by several violent coughs. Pedestrians passing by glanced at him with sympathy, and then said: "It's not easy for me, old man!" But others could not believe that this inconspicuous "old man" was none other than Wan Qingshan, the Black Bat elder, one of the four elders of the once powerful "Butterfly Gate Sect" in the martial arts world!
